```{r}
#| fig-cap: High-coverage community districts under both strategies (66 % coverage). 
#| label: fig-hiimpact-communities-map
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 9

targets::tar_read(plotdata_coverage_approach_choro) |>
                plot_coverage_map()  +
                scale_fill_mpxnyc(name = "", na.translate = FALSE, option = "light") +
                theme_mpxnyc_blank(legend.position = "bottom",
                                strip.text.y.left = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14, angle = 65, margin = ggplot2::margin(0,0,0,0), color = "#636363"),
                                strip.clip = "off")  

```
